findings.summary: PRISMA 2020, PRISMA-S, PRISMA-ScR, and PRISMA-LSR contracts maintain strict reporting-completeness boundaries without conduct conflation.
findings.evidence: PRISMA-S ledger fails closed on empty or whitespace values; PRISMA 2020 flow validates arithmetic and supports new and updated flow variants.

recommendations: Never represent PRISMA reporting completeness as a guarantee of search effectiveness or conduct adequacy.
